args.description: Pixel Heaven native pixel art. Slightly overhead 3/4 RPG view, orthogonal ground (not isometric diamond), upper-left light, crisp 1px clusters, selective dark outlines, warm muted limited palette. Transparent background, no text, no watermark, no scene or ground platform, entire silhouette inside canvas. Home rogue: low alert stance, TWO short daggers one in EACH hand, short hood and sage cloth, dark leather clothing, round belt emblem. Full body facing south. Native 32x48, visible adult height 40 pixels, top 8 pixels empty, feet at bottom ground anchor (16,48), no enlarged chibi head. Modest practical clothing. Use only combat_v1 colors: #2E342F #454C43 #E9DDC6 #CBBDA2 #BAC4C1 #7B9299 #4D626B #7F9B86 #526F61 #65899A #B46F55 #784C40 #D6A078 #9285A7 #665D7A #DEC58B #AF9254 #896849 #5D4D3B #9A9B88 #676F63 #D1A382 #9A6E52 #4C433E

postProcessing: Uniform pivot-centred lossless packing; no body scaling.
Mapped RGB to combat_v1 nearest colors without dithering; alpha unchanged.
Hit generated as four frames (API minimum), selected 0,1,3 to deliver three.
Constant direction-specific vertical translation from idle foot to declared pivot, applied unchanged to every frame; offsets in frames.json. No per-frame crop or scale.
referenceRightsBasis: Original textual descriptions, no third-party reference image uploaded.
